state_binding.freshness: V43 remains a current live reference assembly but is no longer the required mechanism architecture.

intent: Define the mechanism-independent functional and geometric requirements of the industrial bottle-labeling station, register multiple plausible bottle capture/rotation mechanism families, and screen those candidates against the same deterministic obligations before selecting any architecture for new CAD development.

projected_steps.title: Freeze the mechanism-independent authoritative constraint baseline
expected_outputs: CAB IXOR+ source geometry and label-presentation constraints
D48 x H180 product geometry and relevant product-flow envelope
conveyor travel/entry/exit relationship
known hard-stop/indexing geometry and existing validated clearances
explicit UNKNOWN fields where peel, transfer, support, neighbor, or mounting constraints are not yet sufficiently bound

projected_steps.title: Bind the functional bottle-handling obligation set independent of mechanism
expected_outputs: ENTRY -> INDEX -> CAPTURE -> ROTATE -> LABEL_TRANSFER -> WRAP -> RELEASE -> EXIT functional chain
support/restraint obligations
rotation-source obligation
reaction-force-path obligation
label-transfer relationship obligation
entry/release/neighbor-clearance obligations
mounting/support integrity obligation

projected_steps.title: Register a diverse bounded candidate mechanism family set
expected_outputs: Candidate A: preserved V43 Prism fit-check arrangement
moving driven wrap-belt assembly against support rollers
translating support-roller carrier
pivoting support-roller arm/carrier
moving side-wall or side-belt drive that advances/rotates the bottle
pinch-belt or multi-roller wrap architecture
other explicit mechanism only when its assumptions and provenance are stated

projected_steps.title: Screen every candidate against the same deterministic requirement matrix
expected_outputs: per-candidate PASS/FAIL/UNRESOLVED by functional obligation
required source evidence and missing primitives per candidate
disproved assumptions retained as negative evidence
no candidate selected by aesthetics or current CAD convenience

projected_steps.title: Select the next candidate eligible for deterministic CAD prototyping or identify the next high-value discriminating test
expected_outputs: candidate eligibility decision grounded in obligation coverage
bounded geometry/modeling contract for a future write-authorized plan, or
explicit unresolved state and next diagnostic test when no candidate is sufficiently justified

acceptance_gate: PLAN-0010 selects an investigation/prototyping candidate only. It cannot grant mechanical acceptance. No candidate is accepted until operating-state restraint, rotation, label transfer, reaction path, mounting, reachable-motion clearance, release, and product-flow obligations are verified across their required temporal scope.
no_write_boundary: No SOLIDWORKS move, transform, rebuild, save, mate creation, suppression change, component insertion, or geometry creation is authorized by PLAN-0010.
